target.description: Estimate peak alpha frequency and intrinsic timescale, then characterize age relationships and their dependence on sensorimotor versus association hierarchy.

dataset.description: Original resting ECoG release Zenodo 16954184, linked by the paper; author README links the associated concept record 16954183.

cohort.description: Thirteen cross-sectional epilepsy-monitoring participants, approximately ages 3–33, with variable coverage of six cortical regions.

split.description: Original age/hierarchy regressions use the observed clinical cohort; no paper prediction holdout is defined. Local participant-held-out PAF/INT errors constitute an extension.

inputs.description: Resting ECoG, participant age, cortical-region assignments and montage/channel information.

preprocessing.description: Paper preprocessing and Lorentzian spectral fitting are documented, but historical fork identity, knee-to-timescale conversion and paper 3–14 Hz versus code 2–14 Hz alpha selection require reconciliation.

metric.description: PAF, INT and their age/hierarchy regression coefficients, correlations and R² quantify associations. R² is explanatory fit here, not a protected prediction baseline.

aggregation.description: The author notebook pools eligible time rows within participant/region or context, then regresses participant summaries against log2 age; the interaction uses participant-region summaries.

full_panel.description: Preserve the complete original thirteen-participant descriptive panel, with each participant contributing only their actual eligible coverage of Postcentral_gyrus, Precentral_gyrus, Superior_temporal_gyrus, Middle_frontal_gyrus, Middle_temporal_gyrus and Supramarginal_gyrus. Required source families include native PAF/INT extraction and QC; participant-region, pooled-context and omnibus distributions/means/quartiles; both metrics versus log2 age for omnibus, sensorimotor, association and all six individual regions; the complete six-region BH correction separately for each metric; pooled participant-region PAF–INT Pearson correlation; INT ~ C(ctx)*PAF + log2(age); and both context-specific INT ~ PAF + log2(age) models. Retain all coefficients, inference and sample/coverage provenance, including nonsignificant results. The complete primary-paper/table/supplement correspondence, exact numerical references and any additional companion panels remain unresolved. Prospective grouped spectral smoothing, participant-clustered/paired sensitivities and held-out prediction are distinct extensions, not replacement source controls. The ten scalar findings declared here are a partial scientific-summary view only. Original regional families, identity-indexed distributions, model/inference tables and native output lineage require structured schema support; no reduction across those axes is introduced.

permitted_observations.description: Use the original resting ECoG recordings, original participant ages, cortical-region assignments and channel/montage metadata, together with the source paper and its exposed figures/tables. The paper+data condition excludes author analysis code; paper+data+author-code adds only the authenticated pinned author code under a common original-data/evaluation protocol. Source figures and aggregates are allowed inputs but cannot replace independently executed derivation from authentic recordings and verified granular outputs. No new participant split or prospective prediction targets are introduced. The exact delivery, code dependency and exposure manifests remain unfrozen.

Incomplete full finding panel: the ten retained scalar estimands do not replace original six-region age-effect families, participant-region/context distributions, model coefficient/inference tables, complete within-metric six-region BH corrections or source-native verification outputs. Runnable interface implementations/spectral-smoothing-v1/smoothing.py --spectra --packet --output-directory emits literal-source and prospective grouped spectral tables plus row-neighbor lineage. It stops before the author 58.5–61.5 Hz interpolation with buffer 5; raw filtering/resampling/multitaper generation, custom spectral fitting and PAF/INT extraction are not supplied by it.

Runnable interface implementations/initial-evaluator-v1/evaluator.py analyze --parameters --packet --output computes supplied-table QC counts, participant_region, participant_context_pooled_time_rows, participant_omnibus_pooled_time_rows, source_age_models, source_region_level_INT_PAF_interaction, source_context_INT_PAF_age_models and source_pooled_region_PAF_INT_correlation. It consumes supplied INT without resolving its estimator and is not an independent verifier that an analysis used authentic ECoG.

Required source-native verification must bind original recording/channel/region/window identities to spectra and native parameter rows (fit0, PAF, PAA, INT, offset, knee, exponent), the abs(fit0)<0.2 mask, missingness, Gaussian smoothing/refill lineage, and all participant summaries including quartiles, mean weights and represented regions. These authentic ordered output identities are not frozen.

For every age model, independently reconstruct the actual participant design matrix, coefficients, n, residual degrees of freedom, covariance/standard errors, t and p values, R-squared and the complete six-region within-metric BH family. For the joint/context coupling models and pooled correlation, preserve the paired participant-region identity table and source nonrobust covariance while disclosing nesting. Required complete coefficient/covariance tables and their derivation of each reported scalar lack an independent authenticated verifier.

The postfit implementation has prospective stable-time sorting, explicit Gaussian sigma, participant-clustered sensitivity and equal-observed-region paired contrast; its score-heldout route introduces prediction. These are separate sensitivities/extensions, not substitutes for the original descriptive source analyses or their literal historical execution.

Published figures, printed statistical tables and notebook outputs are allowed inputs and exposed results. A program that copies them, including a source coefficient or categorical significance claim, is insufficient. Independent operator execution on authentic inputs and verification of all required granular outputs must precede any computational reproduction admission.

Admission_policy is omitted: no complete native evaluator, submitted-analysis interface manifest, authentic-data/ordered panel identities or independent output-verification program has been frozen. Existing software hashes cannot be promoted into these missing scientific identities.
